shadows.name: glow-active
shadows.purpose: Focus glow around inputs and primary buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #10b981; color: #030303; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #10b981; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: transparent; color: #34d399; border-color: #34d399; }

narrative.overview: AgriSense AI employs a visual language that matches high-tech telemetry precision with natural organic weight. The design is structured to serve both small-scale rural cultivators and village-level advisors under field conditions. It relies on crisp typography, flat-layered structures, and natural leaf-and-soil values.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast typography optimized for outdoor mobile screens.
Organic color markers representing health (deep green), warning (amber), and flowers/accent (orchid petal).
Glassmorphic overlays with strict, crisp borders to define hierarchy without heavy drop shadows.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Body text must always maintain at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Gray text on a dark background is forbidden; use slightly lighter neutral values instead to guarantee outdoor readability.

rules.name: The Heading Balance Rule
rules.body: Heading titles (H1–H3) must utilize text-wrap: balance to prevent awkward orphaned words and uneven layout breaks.

rules.name: The Stacking Border Rule
rules.body: To partition surfaces, use thin borders (border-color 8% white) rather than shadows. Shadows should only appear under glass container overlays to indicate interactive depth on hover.

dos: Do use emerald green (#10b981) exclusively for positive actions, verified states, and active items.
Do enforce a line-length limit of 75ch on all paragraphs to preserve readability on mobile screens.
Do keep card borders clean and thin (1px) using semi-transparent white.
donts: Don't use neon gradients or float elements with thick drop shadows.
Don't use tiny, uppercase, wide-tracked eyebrows above headers.
Don't round cards or dialogs beyond 12px.
